transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Tuesday, August 4. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. SC expands ambit of Sec 498A to cover cruelty in live-ins too. The Supreme Court has extended legal protection to live-in relationships. These relationships are now covered under Section 498A of the IPC. The court stated that the law must adapt to changing societal norms. Cruelty within such relationships will now be punishable by law. Census phase 2 to begin Aug 17, will capture caste, parents' birth details. The Census 2027 population enumeration phase begins August 17 in snow-bound northern areas. This phase will capture caste details for the first time since 1931. Parents' date and birthplace will also be recorded as declared by respondents. Passport and Aadhaar numbers may be collected voluntarily during the exercise. India crosses 20k organ transplants/yr for 1st time. India performed a record 20,138 organ transplants in 2025, a significant increase over previous years. Delhi-NCR led the nation in transplant procedures, while Tamil Nadu topped deceased organ donors. India now ranks third globally in total organ transplants, after the US and China. Deceased donor transplants continue to fall short of the substantial demand for organs. J and K: Days after Kulgam terror attack, man with grenade held in Pulwama. A suspect was apprehended in Pulwama carrying a hand grenade and anti-national posters. This arrest occurred during a security operation following recent migrant worker killings. Authorities booked the local man under stringent anti-terror laws, including the UAPA. Security forces are increasing patrols and checkpoints across the valley. Lower min age for MD, directors to 18: Parliamentary panel. A parliamentary panel suggests lowering the minimum director age to eighteen years. The committee also backs raising the maximum director age to seventy-five years. Special NCLT benches for insolvency matters are recommended for efficient asset resolution. The panel proposes retaining the ten crore net profit threshold for CSR applicability. 'Carry documents always': Legal experts warn Indian diaspora in US. Widespread reports of non-citizens being detained by the US Department of Homeland Security (DHS) during domestic travel within the US, have prompted immigration attorneys to advise their clients, including H-1B visa holders, to carry documents that establish their lawful immigration status or authorised stay in the US. Withdraw cases, allow youngsters to continue studies: SC to states. The Supreme Court permitted governments to withdraw cases against student protesters. This move aims to allow students to pursue their studies without prosecution fears. However, cases against individuals with criminal records will not be dropped. The court will also establish guidelines for the use of graded force by police. Government to sell up to 6.5 percent stake in LIC, may mop up rupees 31k cr. The government is selling up to 6.5 percent of LIC shares through an offer for sale. This divestment aims to meet minimum public shareholding norms ahead of schedule. The offer begins Tuesday and closes Wednesday with a base price of rupees 382. Successful sale will raise approximately rupees 31,400 crore for the government. 'You created magic': Rohit Sharma hails T Dilip as India replace fielding coach. Former India captain Rohit Sharma paid tribute to T Dilip after the former India fielding coach was replaced by Subhadeep Ghosh, thanking him for his work with the team over the last five years. Humpback sightings fall 60 percent as weakened seabirds reach Australia's east. Unusual whale and seabird sightings in the Southern Ocean suggest changing ocean conditions. Marine heat waves are affecting waters around Australia and Antarctica. These warming events disrupt food webs and push marine life off course. Limited monitoring hinders understanding of these significant ecosystem shifts. Scientists survey Mount Ararat glacier above 5,000m for first ice core. A German-Turkish research team has completed the first scientific survey of the glacier on Mount Ararat, Turkey's highest peak, to study its potential as a record of climate and human history. Scientists mapped the shrinking ice cap to identify the best site for drilling the mountain's first ice core, hoping it will reveal thousands of years of environmental and archaeological information before melting erases it.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Twisha Sharma Death Case: Retired Judge Giribala Moves High Court For Bail. Retired district judge Giribala on Monday moved the Madhya Pradesh High Court seeking bail in the Twisha Sharma death case after her plea was rejected by a Bhopal district court on July 25. MP Ends Services Of 252 Special Educators, Future Of 1 Lakh CWSN Students In Doubt. The Madhya Pradesh government has discontinued the services of 252 special educators, raising concerns over support for nearly one lakh Children with Special Needs (CWSN). NEET UG Counselling 2026: AIQ Round 1 Begins August 4, Classes From September 8. The first round of NEET UG 2026 All India Quota counselling will begin on August 4, with the academic session starting on September 8. MP Police Promotion Row: PHQ Receives Hundreds Of Complaints, Review DPC Ordered. The Madhya Pradesh Police Headquarters has ordered a review Departmental Promotion Committee after receiving hundreds of complaints over alleged irregularities in recent promotions. Bhopal Police To Get Major Housing Upgrade With 1,000 New Quarters. Bhopal Police will get 1,000 new residential quarters to ease the shortage of official accommodation. Indore High Court: Girl Says Mother Spends Too Much Time On Mobile Phone. During a custody-related habeas corpus hearing, the Indore Bench of the Madhya Pradesh High Court recorded a girl's unusual complaint that her mother was constantly engaged with her mobile phone. Madhya Pradesh becomes fourth UCC State; three more join the queue. Adivasis protest in Jabalpur, Bhopal against Chutka nuclear project. Woman, Her Lover Tied Together, Paraded In Madhya Pradesh Village Over Extramarital Affair; 3 Booked. Taxed as Commercial, Planned as Residential, RWAs Flag Infrastructure Stress. Shops in residential areas: Traders seek permanent solution as MP pauses sealing drive. Datia bypoll: Boost for Congress, Reality check for BJP. Congress keeps Datia seat in Madhya Pradesh, defeats BJP rival by 6,016 votes.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Citadel Securities' Shah Says Markets Questioning Warsh's Plans. Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is creating fresh uncertainty for investors by pledging to rein in inflation without explaining how he intends to do so, according to Citadel Securities. Yen surges to three-month peak, dollar pares losses after intervention. GLOBAL-FOREX/ (UPDATE 5):FOREX-Yen surges to three-month peak, dollar pares losses after intervention Yen Holds Steady in US Hours After Speculation of Intervention. The yen held steady through the New York trading session on Monday, after a sharp advance earlier in the day that sparked speculation authorities may have intervened to support the currency again after last week's coordinated action between the US and Japan. Oil drops, stocks gain amid Iran peace hopes; yen firms as investors watch for further intervention. GLOBAL-MARKETS/ (WRAPUP 7):GLOBAL MARKETS -Oil drops, stocks gain amid Iran peace hopes; yen firms as investors watch for further intervent Wall Street rallies, Dow closes at record on Iran talks optimism. USA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 6):US STOCKS-Wall Street rallies, Dow closes at record on Iran talks optimism South Korea Is Becoming Uninvestable, Too. South Korea is home to the world's hottest and most volatile stock market this year. The Kospi's near 40 percent tumble in just 27 trading days is comparable to China's market crash in 2015. But with an easing of the global AI stock rout, it's natural to ask if the benchmark index is destined for a rebound. Citadel Securities Says Bull Market Drivers Are 'Firmly Intact'. Forces that propelled US stocks to record highs this year remain "firmly intact" after a reset in retail investors' speculative trading, according to Citadel Securities. New closing auction sparks rare Nifty-Sensex split amid low participation. Brokers mixed in view with some terming the 200 pt surge in Nifty in two minutes an anomaly, while others attributed lower awareness leading to a demand -supply mismatch Credit to tech infra sector doubles in two years. Bank loans for India's technology infrastructure sector have doubled in two years. Elevation plans twin stake sales in Paytm, Meesho after June-quarter earnings. Saif Partners India IV Ltd, Saif III Mauritius Co. Ltd, and Elevation Capital V Ltd will be selling up to 14.9 million shares, which equal 2.3 percent of Paytm. India shines beyond traditional strengths at CWG. India exceeded expectations by finishing fourth with 39 medals at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, despite the exclusion of several traditional medal-winning sports. SBI Funds Q1 Results: PAT rises 3 percent YoY to rupees 873 crore in first earnings after listing. SBI Funds Management reported a standalone profit of rupees 873 crore for the June quarter, up 3.3 percent from last year. Despite weak market sentiment, retail investor confidence remained strong, with equity inflows driving QAAUM growth to rupees 12.6 trillion, maintaining its largest asset manager status. Palantir shares edge higher ahead of Q2 earnings as investors eye strong revenue growth. Wall Street expects Palantir to deliver another strong quarter, with revenue projected to rise 80.8 percent year over year, accelerating from the 48 percent growth recorded in the corresponding period last year Demand for 10 aircraft per year in 2 decades: ATR. ATR forecasts demand for ten aircraft annually in India over twenty years. IREDA Q1 Results: Net profit rises 37 percent YoY to rupees 339 crore; asset quality stays stable. IREDA's Q1 FY27 showed mixed results with net profit at rupees 339 crore, up 37.1 percent YoY but down 31.3 percent sequentially. Revenue rose 15.5 percent YoY to rupees 2,249 crore, offset by increased finance costs and provisions, impacting profitability despite stable asset quality. Book returned to Australian library after 150 years. A rare 1858 book has finally returned to an Australian library after an estimated 150 years, but its mystery borrower cannot be found. Why did Nifty 50 jump 200 points in the final minutes of trade? Here's what happened. The Indian stock market saw unusual divergence as the Nifty 50 surged 1.60 percent to 24,773, while the Sensex gained 0.70 percent to 78,639. This occurred due to SEBI's new Closing Auction Session mechanism aimed at improving price discovery. India tears down tax barriers for global money. India has proposed easing tax rules for offshore investment funds using India-based managers by removing size and investor limits, aiming to attract foreign capital and boost domestic fund management activity. HSBC, SBI and ICICI Bank get half of India's FCNR flows under incentive window. Public sector banks got $8.8 billion under the scheme, private sector banks $10.7 billion and foreign banks $8.4 billion. The remaining came into small finance banks and cooperative banks, the data showed. Michigan cyclosporiasis outbreak leaves 2 dead. Michigan cyclosporiasis outbreak: The recent cyclosporiasis outbreak in Michigan has resulted in its first two fatalities, sparking concern among health officials. Wall Street climbs as crude oil prices plunge, Amazon jumps 5.3 percent. At 11:44 a.m. ET the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1.06 percent , the S and P 500 gained 1.22 percent , the Nasdaq Composite jumped 1.87 percent Backrooms to Bankipur: Making of Prashant Kishor. In a remarkable turn, Prashant Kishor clinched his first electoral win in the Bankipur byelection. Marriott Q2 earnings rise on higher hotel prices, annual room revenue outlook raised. Marriott International reported stronger-than-expected Q2 earnings, highlighting resilient global travel demand. RevPAR rose 3.4 percent overall, with the US and Canada increasing 5 percent . However, international RevPAR fell 0.5 percent . Trump calls Iran leaders 'duplicitous' over talks. President Trump criticized Iran's leadership for perceived duplicity regarding negotiations with the United States. US stock market today: Wall Street futures gain as easing Iran tensions trigger sharp fall in oil prices. US stock futures rose on 3 August after Trump cancelled military strikes on Iran, easing tensions and lowering crude oil prices. Dow futures increased 413 points, while S and P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures also gained. Investors remain cautious amid concerns about inflation and interest rates. ONGC tucks away oil for India's rainy days. India's Oil and Natural Gas Corp will reserve half of its planned oil storage. Top Gainers and Losers on 3 August: Urban Company, Pine Labs, Redington, Paytm, TCS, Meesho among top gainers. Indian equities surged nearly 1 percent on Monday, led by a decline in crude oil prices and strong IT sector buying. The Nifty 50 rose to 24,573 and the Sensex to 78,677, extending gains to a fourth session. Nifty IT and Private Bank were top gainers.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. HDFC Bank launches new savings accounts for senior citizens, women: Check features and benefits. HDFC Bank introduced two new savings accounts for specific customer groups. The Specialé Senior Citizen Savings Account offers security and doorstep banking services. Women can avail the SavingsMax Account with lifestyle and health benefits. Finance Ministry moves to enable MDR on UPI , Here's what scrapping zero MDR provision means for UPI users. The Union Ministry of Finance has made moves to enable merchant discount rates on UPI and proposed scrapping the zero MDR provision. We take a look at what this decision could mean for UPI customers. ITR refund 2026: Filed income tax return within July 31, 2026 deadline? Here's when you may get your tax refund. Taxpayers who filed their income tax returns by the July 31 deadline are now awaiting refunds. The Income Tax Department processes refunds after successful e-verification of the filed returns. REITs versus REIT mutual funds: Structure, taxation rules, returns and suitability for investors compared. REITs and REIT mutual funds offer investors exposure to the real estate sector but differ in structure, taxation, and returns. While REITs focus on rental income from properties, REIT funds combine REIT exposure with real estate equities. Using pick-up and drop for car service? Know who pays if an accident happens. Service centres cannot evade responsibility for accidents during vehicle pick-up and drop-off. A signed waiver does not absolve them of negligence or deficient service. Insurance companies may still cover claims, then recover costs from the negligent party. Dealers face direct liability, while manufacturers' responsibility is less automatic. New Fund Offer: Should you invest in an NFO when a similar mutual fund with a proven track record exists?. If a similar mutual fund with a proven track record already exists in the market, experts say investors should prefer an established scheme unless the NFO offers a genuinely differentiated strategy that complements their portfolio and investment goals. Will FD investors get higher interest rates as Iran-US war continues and inflation shoots?. Rising inflation and increased credit demand are pushing banks towards higher fixed deposit rates. Banks are also facing competition from small savings schemes and government securities. Deposit growth has slowed while credit demand has climbed significantly in recent months. This widening gap may compel banks to attract more deposits through better rates. Value funds: Only two schemes have negative alpha; Quant and DSP lead category in benchmark outperformance. Only two value funds have negative alpha, indicating they lag their benchmark indices, while Quant Value Fund and DSP Value Fund record the highest positive alpha. The contrast in alpha was also reflected in return performance, with the positive-alpha funds delivering better returns. Has EPFO wage ceiling been raised to rupees 25,000? Here's what report says about the monthly contribution limit. Finance Ministry has approved an increase in EPF wage ceiling to rupees 25,000 monthly from current rupees 15,000, as per a Moneycontrol report. If approved this would expand coverage to more salaried workers. How to report F and O income in ITR for AY 2026-27: Deadline, turnover, audit rules and key changes in tax forms. F and O trading is treated as non-speculative business income and must be reported under business income in ITR. For AY 2026-27, taxpayers need to disclose F and O turnover and income in dedicated fields in ITR forms. They also need to comply with tax audit and carry-forward rules. HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank raise FCNR (B) interest rates: Depositors to get up to 6.25 percent rates on select tenures; check details. HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank have raised FCNR(B) deposit rates by twenty-five basis points. This increase applies to select US dollar FCNR(B) deposit tenures, effective August 2026. The government will bear hedging costs on three to five-year FCNR(B) deposits until September 2026. How capital gains on foreign shares are computed and taxed in India. Upon returning to India, the person must compute capital gains from US shares in INR, using the exchange rate from the sale date. No concessions for rupee depreciation apply. Long-term gains are taxed at 12.5 percent , and disclosure of foreign assets is required for tax purposes. Can housing societies charge separately for facilities like gyms or swimming pools in addition to maintenance fees? Know what the law says. Are housing societies allowed to impose user charges for facilities like gyms or swimming pools separately from maintenance? Know what the law says. The law says the Apartment Owners Association cannot impose arbitrary, retrospective or discriminatory charges that effectively deny equal access to common amenities. RBI provides banks greater flexibility to determine bulk deposit interest rates; changes effective from October 1, 2026. New Reserve Bank of India rules will change bank deposit interest rate disclosures starting October 2026. Banks will gain flexibility in setting interest rates for bulk deposits of three crore rupees and above. These institutions must now publish bulk deposit rates on their websites daily by ten AM. What are Alternative Investment Funds? Experts explain SEBI's three AIF categories and how they differ from mutual funds. SEBI's new GARUDA framework has brought Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) into the spotlight. While the industry has grown rapidly over the past decade, AIFs remain less familiar than mutual funds. Here's how experts explain the investment vehicle, who it is meant for and how SEBI classifies it. Home insurance during monsoon: What it covers, key exclusions, and why homeowners should check their policy. Monsoon damage isn't limited to leaks and flooding. Experts explain what home insurance covers, key exclusions, and why both homeowners and tenants should review their policies. Flexi-cap funds stay 61 percent invested in large caps, multi-cap funds remain balanced: Report. Despite flexibility in their mandate, flexi-cap funds remain more biased towards large-cap stocks, with 61 percent allocation. On the other hand, multi-cap funds maintain a more balanced exposure across large, mid, and small-cap segments. Annapurna Bhandar August instalment: Here's why you have not received rupees 3,000 yet and what to do to fix it. Although payments for Annapurna Bhandar are generally credited in a phased manner during the first week of the month, many bank accounts have yet to receive the funds Market cap performance: Large caps lag as micro-cap and small-cap stocks outperform in 2026. Here's our TrendMap, your quick guide to the performance of different investment segments. No single segment always leads. In this edition, we present a 10-year equity performance tracker, ranking annual returns across market-cap segments. Investors' risk appetite has turned more selective in 2026 so far. Salary hike: Delhi Disaster Management Authority personnel get 100 percent increase , How much will employees be paid now?. Delhi has approved 100 percent salary hike for DDMA personnel, including project officers, district project officers, and project coordinators. This is the first such increase in 16 years, since the positions were created in 2009. 8th Pay Commission salary calculator: How Level 1 employees' basic pay could double in just 7 years. Employee and pensioner organisations have urged the 8th Pay Commission to increase the rate of annual increment and merge Dearness Allowance (DA) with basic pay once it reaches a specified level. Estate planning: Why passing on wealth during your lifetime can be a smarter succession strategy. Gifting and charity, in cash and kind, during one's lifetime offers the scope for creating shared experiences of celebration, travel, entertainment and eating out together, for both generations. The caveat, of course, is the inability and perhaps unwillingness of seniors to make spending decisions. Bank failed to return property papers after home loan closure: How a Delhi couple got rupees 15.5 lakh compensation. A Delhi couple won rupees 15.5 lakh in compensation after Axis Bank lost their original property papers and failed to return them after the closure of their rupees 1.41 crore home loan.
